div.div:
حَلَائِبُ used as a pl. of حَلْبَةٌ [q. v.], because the latter has the meaning of ↓ حَلِيبَةٌ . (Msb.) ―
-b2- Also Companies, assemblies, or troops. (K.) ―
-b3- And The sons of the paternal uncle: (K:) or a man's assistants, or auxiliaries, consisting of the sons of the paternal uncle in particular. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
